declaration: Committed before calibration outcomes; exact generator code is bound by the execution code hash.

generators.iid: Normal stationary unit variance, independent a/b and normal control columns
generators.ar1: Gaussian AR(1), rho=.3, innovation sigma=sqrt(1-rho^2), initial 0, burn=100
generators.regression: Response a + .2*x0 - .1*x1; two independent normal controls; tested intercept
generators.plant: Add .35 standardized units to a/response; same frozen generator and seeds as null
generators.family: 46 independent uniform null p-values, 1000 families, Holm FWER/BH global-null FDR

seeds: 20261008 + case_index*1000000 + world; resampling seed +100000; family seed +900000000
acceptance: Nominal .05 inside each case's 95% Wilson null CI; planted 95% lower >= .8; family upper <= .075. No widening, seed changes or retries. Canary cannot confer acceptance.
